user_data.description: A data frame of user ratings. Rows represent users, columns represent items, and entries represent user ratings for items

algorithm.description: The algorithm to be used for creating the recommendation model. Collaborative filtering, content-based filtering and hybrid filtering.

Below is a practical, step‑by‑step guide that covers everything from the initial design phase to the final deployment of a modern, high‑performance e‑commerce front‑end. Feel free to skip sections that already exist in your project or to adapt the stack to your team’s preferences. --- ## 1. Planning & Design | Step | What to Do | Why It Matters | |------|------------|----------------| | **Define Goals** | List core features (product catalog, search, filters, cart, checkout, reviews, personalization). | Keeps the scope focused. | | **User Personas** | Create personas for shoppers, admins, and guests. | Drives UX decisions. | | **Wireframes** | Sketch low‑fidelity screens (home, category, product, cart, checkout). | Visualizes layout before coding. | | **Prototypes** | Build interactive prototypes in Figma/Adobe XD. | Validates flow with stakeholders. | | **Design System** | Decide on a component library (Tailwind, Material‑UI, Chakra‑UI) or build your own. | Ensures consistency and speeds up development. | > **Tip:** Use Figma’s “Design Tokens” feature to sync colors, spacing, and typography across the team. --- ## 2. Choose the Tech Stack | Category | Options | Recommendation | |----------|---------|----------------| | **Framework** | React, Vue, Angular, Svelte | **React + Next.js** (SSR + SSG + ISR) | | **State Management** | Redux Toolkit, Zustand, Recoil, Vuex | **Redux Toolkit** (simple, well‑documented) | | **Styling** | Tailwind CSS, Styled‑Components, Emotion | **Tailwind CSS** (utility‑first, fast) | | **Type System** | TypeScript | **Yes** – catches bugs early | | **Testing** | Jest + React Testing Library, Cypress | **Jest + RTL** for unit, **Cypress** for E2E | | **CI/CD** | GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, CircleCI | **GitHub Actions** (free for public repos) | | **Hosting** | Vercel, Netlify, AWS Amplify, Cloudflare Pages | **Vercel** (native Next.js support) | | **Analytics** | Google Analytics, Plausible, Segment | **Plausible** (privacy‑friendly) | | **Performance** | Lighthouse, Web Vitals | **Lighthouse** (built‑in Chrome DevTools) | > **Why Next.js?** > * Server‑Side Rendering (SSR) for SEO. > * Static Site Generation (SSG) for fast product pages. > * Incremental Static Regeneration (ISR) for dynamic content. > * Built‑in Image Optimization. --- ## 3. Project Skeleton ```bash npx create-next-app@latest ecommerce-frontend --typescript cd ecommerce-frontend npm install tailwindcss postcss autoprefixer npx tailwindcss init -p ``` **Folder structure** ``` /components # Reusable UI components /pages # Next.js pages (home, product, cart, etc.) /styles # Tailwind config, global CSS /hooks # Custom React hooks /store # Redux slices /utils # API helpers, formatters /tests # Jest + RTL tests /public # Static assets ``` **Tailwind config (`tailwind.config.js`)** ```js module.exports = { content: [ "./pages/**/*.{ts,tsx}", "./components/**/*.{ts,tsx}", ], theme: { extend: {}, }, plugins: [], } ``` --- ## 4. Core Components ### 4.1 Product Card ```tsx // components/ProductCard.tsx import Image from 'next/image' import Link from 'next/link' export interface ProductCardProps { id: string title: string price: number imageUrl: string rating?: number } export const ProductCard: React.FC = ({ id, title, price, imageUrl, rating = 0, }) => (

{title}

${price.toFixed(2)}

) ``` ### 4.2 Cart Context ```tsx // store/cartSlice.ts import { createSlice, PayloadAction } from '@reduxjs/toolkit' interface CartItem { productId: string quantity: number } interface CartState { items: CartItem[] } const initialState: CartState = { items: [] } export const cartSlice = createSlice({ name: 'cart', initialState, reducers: { addToCart(state, action: PayloadAction) { const existing = state.items.find(i => i.productId === action.payload.productId) if (existing) { existing.quantity += action.payload.quantity } else { state.items.push(action.payload) } }, removeFromCart(state, action: PayloadAction) { state.items = state.items.filter(i => i.productId !== action.payload) }, clearCart(state) { state.items = [] }, }, }) export const { addToCart, removeFromCart, clearCart } = cartSlice.actions export default cartSlice.reducer ``` --- ## 5. API Integration ### 5.1 Fetching Products ```tsx // utils/api.ts export const fetchProducts = async () => { const res = await fetch('https://api.example.com/products') if (!res.ok) throw new Error('Failed to fetch products') return res.json() } ``` ### 5.2 Next.js Data Fetching ```tsx // pages/index.tsx import { GetStaticProps } from 'next' import { fetchProducts } from '../utils/api' import { ProductCard } from '../components/ProductCard' export const getStaticProps: GetStaticProps = async () => { const products = await fetchProducts() return { props: { products }, revalidate: 60 } // ISR } export default function Home({ products }) { return (

) } ``` --- ## 6. Checkout Flow 1. **Cart Page** – Show items, allow quantity changes, remove items. 2. **Address Form** – Use `react-hook-form` for validation. 3. **Payment Integration** – Stripe Elements or PayPal SDK. 4. **Order Confirmation** – Show order summary, send email via backend webhook. > **Security Tip:** Never store sensitive payment data on the front‑end. Use tokenization (Stripe’s `stripe.createToken`). --- ## 7. Performance & SEO | Technique | How to Implement | |-----------|------------------| | **Image Optimization** | Use Next.js `` component. | | **Code Splitting** | Dynamic imports (`next/dynamic`). | | **Lazy Loading** | `loading="lazy"` on images, `IntersectionObserver` for heavy components. | | **Critical CSS** | Tailwind’s `purge` removes unused styles. | | **SEO Meta Tags** | `next/head` for title, description, Open Graph. | | **Structured Data** | JSON‑LD for products (`
